Use this whenever someone wants an isometric illustration, an explanatory diagram or figure for docs, a blog post, a landing page or an article, a "Linear-sty
frontmatter.compatibility: Written for Claude Code; also runs in Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex and MiniMax Code. Needs Node.js 20.10+, and Chrome or Chromium for the checks.
